evals.name: triggers-on-mz-window-skin
evals.prompt: make an RPG Maker MZ window skin, dark wood with a gold frame
evals.expected_output: Fires /pixel-art:ui. Reads the Window.png row in engine-layouts.md and draws those regions into one frame, because render.py keeps one frame size per spec. Renders with render.py, reads preview.png, and delivers sheet.png at 1x named Window.png.
expectations: Invokes the ui skill, not sprite
Places Window.png regions from engine-layouts.md into one frame
Keeps 9-slice corners as a solid block
Delivers sheet.png at 1x as the asset

evals.name: triggers-on-icon-set-and-font
evals.prompt: an MZ icon set of 16 item icons, plus a bitmap font of the digits 0-9
evals.expected_output: Fires /pixel-art:ui. Lays the icons on the IconSet.png grid from engine-layouts.md without skipping cell 0, and authors the digits as a glyph grid. States unspecified choices in one line.
expectations: Uses the IconSet column count from engine-layouts.md
Does not shift the grid to skip icon 0
Authors the digits as a glyph grid rather than a system font

evals.name: near-miss-single-icon-routes-to-sprite
evals.expected_output: Does not fire /pixel-art:ui. A single item icon is /pixel-art:sprite.
expectations: Does not invoke the ui skill for one item icon

evals.name: near-miss-tileset-routes-to-tileset
evals.prompt: make a grass autotile sheet for RPG Maker MZ
evals.expected_output: Does not fire /pixel-art:ui. A terrain tileset is /pixel-art:tileset.
expectations: Does not invoke the ui skill for an autotile sheet
